about: Stories come from the shared bank: games/shared/stories.json (50+ per level, shuffled every game). This file has the How to play slides and bonus cards.

intro.title: True or False Race
text: Read the story on the board.
Then read one sentence about it.

example.big: Tom got the dog on Monday.

intro.title: Be fast!
text: Decide with your team: true or false?
Hold up T or F when the teacher says go.

intro.title: Win points
text: If it is false, can you say the right answer?

before.name: Fix it!
before.text: False? Say the true sentence for +1

before.name: Silent signal
before.text: No talking at all this story: +2

before.name: Show me
before.text: Point to the sentence that proves it: +1

secret.name: Perfect story
secret.text: +2 for teams with all four right!

secret.name: Your own
secret.text: +2 for writing a new true sentence about it!
